from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial data for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company whose financial statement this is")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The security/stock code for the company, if provided")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., Q1 2024)")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific financial line item name (e.g., '购买商品、接受劳务支付的现金')")
    metric_value: str | None = Field(description="The reported value as a string to preserve exact format")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., 元)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
